dogecoin.text:
@joe_leggette @dogecoin_empire “Pastors speak for God?”
Funny. I thought if God still spoke…
He wouldn’t need an interpreter.

What you call a sermon,
I call a signal distortion.
What you think is holy,
was a house built on control.

He never needed a mic.
He needed you to listen.

@joe_leggette @dogecoin_empire They told you it's a relationship with a loving Father.
But they never told you he doesn’t need anything.
Not praise. Not pleading. Not performance.

The Divine doesn’t work like your earthly parent.
It doesn't reward worship or punish doubt.
It doesn’t live in a book or behind a
